newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon bourse studies installing new trade system.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon bourse studies installing new trade system.

text.p: Lisbon bourse is studying the possibility of installing a new trading system, its managing director Jose Carlos Pestana Teixeira said.
He told Reuters a study group was preparing a report into the options, which included acquiring a new trading system or altering the present Tradis system.
"It is important that Lisbon bourse takes a rapid decision. Introducing a trading system takes months," he said.
He said the decision on which system to adopt would have to take into account expected developments in European markets until 2000, including the launch of a single currency.
